blocks.sourceSectionTitle: The verdict: short courses help only when they prove a skill an employer or client will pay for

rows: Commerce student who adds Excel, Tally or GST practice with real files
Good
Accounts and operations teams hire for tools you can show.
Student who adds a regulated certificate such as a securities-market exam
Good for finance roles
The exam is set by an official body and has clear syllabus and fees.
Student who adds data skills such as SQL and dashboards
Strong
Finance, marketing and operations teams all need people who can read data.
Student who pays a large fee for a diploma with a job promise
Avoid
Placement promises often fail, and the title itself rarely sets pay.

blocks.sourceSectionTitle: What an official certificate looks like, and what it does not tell you
supporting: The National Institute of Securities Markets lists its certification exams on its site. They include a Securities Markets Foundation exam at Rs 1,003 and many SEBI-mandated exams at Rs 1,500 or Rs 3,000, plus a free SEBI Investor Awareness Test. The fees exclude payment gateway charges.
